physical_contract: Same fixed-temperature finite Matsubara action,65x65 core,normal potential,KWT,contacts and physical times. Every RHS uses nonlinear spectral roots. J0 only splits the ETD2 integrator; all spatial degrees of freedom retained.
accuracy_contract: ETD2 predictor/corrector step control measures each state relative to its initial perturbation. One registered temporal refinement compares displacement,current,force and exact torque against initial/remaining response. No tail-relative-only admission.
energy_contract: Nonlinear thermal free energy and its KWT/normal dissipation rate, at fixed bath temperature. This is not conserved internal energy of coupled populations, nor a photon detector transient.
method_contract: Exponential trapezoidal ETD2; evaluate h*phi1 and h*phi2 via Arnoldi on physical coordinates. No auxiliary constant state, no change to constitutive laws or physical times.
scope: Full nonlinear thermal trajectory needed to move beyond saved constitutive snapshots. Stage4 general nonthermal coupling and real-device circuit remain open.

cost_estimate.basis: 2048 nonlinear snapshot roots took22.74s; full trajectory adaptively invokes3x256 roots for predictor/corrected states plus reused spectral tangents. Step/restart count not measured in advance; user-run full horizon.
cost_estimate.workers: At most27workers plus coordinator; reserve2physicalcores on16core/32threadGeminga. BLAS/OMP1; dynamic90percent CPU/RAM budget.
cost_estimate.output: Accepted states,observations,all attempted steps,source/inputSHA256,refinement and nonlinear power diagnostics in scratch. Reserve4GiB.

failure_contract: Fresh output; preserve failure/checkpoints; no implicit rerun,changed constants,clipping or solver fallback. --stop-after-ps changes only observation horizon and labels pilot.
